_doc: The anchor at (50,50) has an out-handle at (66.67,0) away from it, so the Convert tool reads it as SMOOTH (ANCHOR_POINT_TOOLS.md, press-time priority 2): the commit collapses it to a corner, and the out-handle moves onto the anchor. The drag does not matter for a smooth anchor. Named for what it does; the corner-to-smooth case is anchor_point_drag_corner_to_smooth.
name: anchor_point_press_smooth_collapses
